rows.clinical_trial_sponsor: Wyeth is now a wholly owned subsidiary of Pfizer
rows.clinical_trial_responsible_party: Wyeth is now a wholly owned subsidiary of Pfizer
rows.outcome_overview_description: Antibody concentration/geometric mean concentration as measured by ELISA with their corresponding 95% CI immediately before and after the toddler dose for 7 common pneumococcal serotypes (Serotypes 4, 6B, 9V, 14, 18C, 19F, and 23F) and 6 additional pneumococcal serotypes specific to 13vPnC (Serotypes 1, 3, 5, 6A, 7F, and 19A) are presented.
rows.outcome_overview_time_frame: Immediately before (12 months of age) and one month after the toddler dose (13 months of age)
